name: K
source:
K is a mysterious man in a suit of what appears to be armor. His face is hidden by a mask, and no one knows his name or his age - not even him.

[Spoiler]He is later revealed to be Kyle Klim, the son/clone of Sigma.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://zeroescape.wikia.com/wiki/K]Zero Escape Wiki[/url]]
